scope: Preview context isolation for CMS renderers; existing page/theme working-tree changes were included unchanged in both builds.

implementation.description: A local adapter reads the nearest native AppContext and provides only insideStoryblok to its stable child. Context-only route updates still render adapters but do not invalidate unchanged content. Normal parent renders are intentionally preserved; no memo comparator, external store, or global provider replacement is introduced.

regressionTests.before: The render-isolation test failed with 100 content renders after a route-only update; the five compatibility cases passed.
regressionTests.after: All six pass: 100 initial content renders, zero additional unchanged-content renders on route or locale changes; route-aware children still update.
coverage: Nested native AppContext.Provider and React 19 shorthand overrides, including undefined
Ordinary parent updates with mutated content and runtime renderer registration overrides
Public and preview server markup, hydration retaining the server DOM, and editor markers

unit.note: An existing asynchronous GoogleFontsLivePreview test failed in targeted runs; isolated and full-suite reruns passed without changing that test or its component.

validation.typecheck: pnpm run check-types passed; both builds also passed Next TypeScript checks.
validation.lint: oxlint and oxfmt --check passed for all three changed TypeScript files; git diff --check passed.

builds.result: Both passed. TEST=TRUE selects four CMS SSG routes rather than enumerating every published route.

bundles.method: Sum gzip sizes of the distinct shared _app and catch-all JavaScript files in each production build manifest; this is a rendering optimization, not a download reduction.

browser.navigation: Client navigation from the homepage to the first detail page and back passed at both widths in both builds.
browser.drawer: Mobile drawer opened in both builds and its screenshots matched.

pixels.comparison: Count pixels with an RGB channel difference greater than 16; allow zero changed pixels outside controlled external content.
pixels.initialDifference: Mobile homepage: 72463 pixels, entirely within the YouTube iframe loading rectangle (x 32–342, y 5710–5942). Surrounding pixels and all DOM metrics matched.
pixels.followup: Re-ran the mobile homepage with an identical deterministic YouTube iframe document, waiting for iframe load and removal of the existing skeleton in both builds.

browser.existingAssetIssue: Both builds had the same two broken images on the mobile German route; no new broken images appeared.

limitations: Browser coverage is the four sampled routes in this repository configuration, not every consumer site. Actual Storyblok editor connectivity was not exercised in a browser; existing bridge tests and new override/hydration tests cover that behavior. No field LCP/INP improvement is claimed.
